content: 1. Both desipramine and posaconazole increase the QTc interval. Exercise caution and monitor the patient closely. 2. Deutetrabenazine and posaconazole both increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor. At the maximum recommended dose, deutetrabenazine does not prolong the QT interval to a clinically significant extent. However, certain conditions, such as bradycardia, hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, coadministration with other QT-prolonging drugs, or congenital QT prolongation, may increase the risk of torsades de pointes or sudden death. 3. Posaconazole increases dexamethasone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 4. Dexlansoprazole decreases posaconazole levels or effects by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Conversely, posaconazole increases dexlansoprazole levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 5. Posaconazole increases diazepam levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. This applies to all forms of diazepam, including buccal and intranasal formulations. Strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors may reduce diazepam elimination, increasing the risk of adverse reactions. 6. Both dichlorphenamide and posaconazole decrease serum potassium levels. Use caution and monitor. 7. Posaconazole increases dienogest/estradiol valerate levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor for adverse effects such as nausea, irregular uterine bleeding, breast tenderness, and headache. 8. Posaconazole increases digoxin levels by reducing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 9. Posaconazole increases diltiazem levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 10. Both dofetilide and posaconazole increase the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 11. Both dolasetron and posaconazole increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor. 12. Both donepezil and posaconazole increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor. 13. Posaconazole increases doravirine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Coadministration with CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase plasma concentrations and toxicities of doravirine. 14. Both doxepin and posaconazole increase the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 15. Posaconazole increases dronabinol levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Dronabinol is a CYP3A4 substrate. 16. Both dronedarone and posaconazole increase the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 17. Both droperidol and posaconazole increase the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 18. Posaconazole increases duvelisib levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors increases duvelisib AUC, raising the risk of toxicities. Reduce the duvelisib dose to 15 mg BID when coadministered with a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor. 19. Elagolix increases posaconazole levels or effects via P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Posaconazole increases elagolix levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Coadministration of elagolix 200 mg BID with strong CYP3A inhibitors for more than one month is not recommended. Limit elagolix dose to 150 mg daily and CYP3A inhibitor use to six months if coadministered. 20. Posaconazole increases eletriptan levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 21. Eliglustat increases posaconazole levels via P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Monitor therapeutic drug concentrations or consider reducing the dosage of the P-gp substrate and titrate to clinical effect. 22. Posaconazole increases elvitegravir levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Elvitegravir is a CYP3A4 substrate, and coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase its levels. 23. Posaconazole increases the toxicity of enfortumab vedotin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Enfortumab vedotin is an antibody-drug conjugate that releases monomethyl auristatin E (MMAE) via proteolytic cleavage. MMAE is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 in vitro. Coadministration with dual P-gp and strong CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase MMAE exposure, raising the risk of enfortumab vedotin toxicities. Monitor closely for signs of toxicities. 24. Posaconazole increases enzalutamide levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 25. Both epinephrine and posaconazole increase the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 26. Both racemic epinephrine and posaconazole increase the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 27. Posaconazole increases erlotinib levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 28. Erythromycin base increases posaconazole levels via P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Both erythromycin base and posaconazole increase the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 29. Erythromycin ethylsuccinate increases posaconazole levels via P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Both erythromycin ethylsuccinate and posaconazole increase the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 30. Erythromycin lactobionate increases posaconazole levels via P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Both erythromycin lactobionate and posaconazole increase the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 31. Erythromycin stearate increases posaconazole levels via P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Both erythromycin stearate and posaconazole increase the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 32. Escitalopram increases posaconazole toxicity via QTc interval prolongation. Posaconazole increases escitalopram levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 33. Esomeprazole decreases posaconazole levels or effects by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Posaconazole increases esomeprazole levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 34. Posaconazole increases estradiol levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 35. Posaconazole increases estradiol vaginal levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Coadministration with CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase plasma concentrations of estrogens and toxicities. 36. Posaconazole increases conjugated synthetic estrogens levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 37. Posaconazole increases esterified estrogens levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 38. Posaconazole increases estropipate levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 39. Posaconazole increases ethinylestradiol levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 40. Posaconazole increases ethosuximide levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 41. Ethotoin decreases posaconazole levels by increasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 42. Posaconazole increases etonogestrel levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 43. Posaconazole increases etoposide levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 44. Posaconazole increases etravirine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 45. Both ezogabine and posaconazole increase each other’s toxicity via QTc interval prolongation. Use caution and monitor. Slight and transient QT prolongation has been observed with ezogabine, particularly when titrated to 1200 mg/day. The QT interval should be monitored when ezogabine is prescribed with agents known to increase the QT interval. 46. Famotidine decreases posaconazole levels or effects by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Use caution and monitor. 47. Posaconazole increases felodipine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Felodipine increases posaconazole levels via P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor. 48. Posaconazole increases fesoterodine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 49. Both fingolimod and posaconazole increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor. 50. Both flecainide and posaconazole increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor. 51. Both fluconazole and posaconazole increase the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 52. Posaconazole increases fludrocortisone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 53. Both fluoxetine and posaconazole increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor. 54. Both fluphenazine and posaconazole increase the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 55. Posaconazole increases flurazepam levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 56. Posaconazole increases flutamide levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 57. Posaconazole increases fluticasone furoate levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase fluticasone systemic exposure. 58. Posaconazole increases fluticasone inhaled levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase fluticasone systemic exposure. 59. Both fluvoxamine and posaconazole increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor. 60. Both formoterol and posaconazole increase the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 61. Fosamprenavir decreases posaconazole levels by an unknown mechanism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Combination may decrease posaconazole plasma concentrations. If administered concomitantly, monitor closely for breakthrough fungal infections. 62. Posaconazole increases fosaprepitant levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 63. Both foscarnet and posaconazole increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor. 64. Fosphenytoin decreases posaconazole levels by increasing its metabolism and via P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor. 65. Posaconazole increases fostamatinib levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase exposure to R406 (fostamatinib’s major active metabolite). Fostamatinib increases posaconazole levels via P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Monitor for toxicities of the P-gp substrate drug, which may require dosage reduction when given concurrently with fostamatinib. 66. Posaconazole increases gefitinib levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Coadministration of strong CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase the risk of gefitinib adverse effects. 67. Both gemifloxacin and posaconazole increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor. 68. Both gepirone and posaconazole increase the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 69. Posaconazole increases glecaprevir/pibrentasvir levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Glecaprevir/pibrentasvir increases posaconazole levels via P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor. 70. Posaconazole increases glimepiride levels by decreasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 71. Posaconazole increases glipizide levels by decreasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 72. Posaconazole increases glyburide levels by decreasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 73. Both granisetron and posaconazole increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor. 74. Posaconazole increases guanfacine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors significantly increase guanfacine plasma concentrations. For extended-release guanfacine, reduce the dosage to half the recommended dose if coadministered. Specific recommendations for immediate-release guanfacine are not available. 75. Both haloperidol and posaconazole increase the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 76. Posaconazole increases hydrocodone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Coadministration with CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase hydrocodone plasma concentrations, potentially leading to fatal respiratory depression. 77. Posaconazole increases hydrocortisone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 78. Posaconazole increases hydroxyprogesterone caproate (DSC) levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 79. Both hydroxyzine and posaconazole increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor. 80. Ibuprofen/famotidine decreases posaconazole levels or effects by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Use caution and monitor.
